title: UGID: Unified Graph Isomorphism for Debiasing Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on internal-representation-level debiasing of LLMs, primarily focusing on gender bias as its experimental case. While it utilizes the BBQ benchmark (which includes a religion category), the paper specifically evaluates the 'BBQ (Gender)' subset and does not provide analysis or benchmarking related to religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
